name: May
flavour: Now you see her. Now you don't.
art_prompt: a slender adult woman with a feminine figure, pale white skin, short straight black bob haircut with bangs, black beret with a small heart-shaped tip, dark eyes, a playful smile and a black star painted on her cheek; wearing a black-and-white horizontally striped long-sleeve shirt under tight black high-waisted suspender overalls with large white buttons, a bright magenta neck scarf and matching gloves, white calf-length stockings and chunky black lace-up ankle boots with white laces; standing straight, both arms relaxed at her sides
motion: walking in place with a slow confident catwalk sway, arms swinging gently
anim_hint: a mime woman in a mime outfit
anim_negative: a helmet, a face on the body, a second head, a weapon, a cape, second leg
portrait_prompt: head and shoulders, her mime face looking at the viewer with mock surprise, hands pressed against a "screen" miming being stuck in a ball
back_hint: She faces away: overalls visible, the boots, no face at all. Both arms hang straight down.
pose_hint: Both arms hang straight down at her sides, hands open, not on the hips. The same slim proportions in every view.

recipe.side_hint: The arms and shoulders should be in the correct position relative to the perspective, it should be avoided that the shoulder closest to the camera is somehow higher than the one on the other side

recipe.art_prompt: a slender adult woman with a feminine figure, pale white skin, short straight black bob haircut with bangs, black beret with a small heart-shaped tip, dark eyes, a playful smile and a black star painted on her cheek; wearing a black-and-white horizontally striped long-sleeve shirt with open cleavage under tight black high-waisted suspender overalls which reach below the knees with large white buttons, a bright magenta neck scarf and matching gloves, white calf-length stockings and chunky black lace-up ankle boots with white laces; standing straight, both arms relaxed at her sides
recipe.side_hint: a clean side profile facing right, both shoulders level and relaxed at the same height, the near shoulder never raised above the far one, one arm hanging relaxed beside the torso, hands open
recipe.pose_hint: Both arms hang straight down at her sides, hands open, not on the hips. The same slim proportions in every view. Her black overalls are suspender overalls: seen from behind, a pointed black back panel rises from the waistband to the middle of her back, and two black suspender straps run from its point up over her black-and-white striped shirt to the tops of her shoulders, both straps clearly visible on her back.
